exposed_development.source_change_after_development: Only malformed failure-phase scoring guard; prior 13-file source archive retained and byte verified; old raw/SDK/audit files unchanged.

evaluation.legacy_metric_contract: result.metrics; global projection may credit unlinked fields; not primary
evaluation.semantic_correctness: requires source review; exact field links do not establish entailment

limitations: Four independent fresh synthetic cases only; one repeat per cell.
Earlier suites and development outputs are exposed.
Credential context and planning instructions change together; no isolated attribution.
New primary scorer differs from historical metrics; no cross-scorer or cross-suite improvement claim.
Structure, exact source-bound field support and status labels do not prove semantic correctness.

planning.credential_map: exact signer and returned-key occurrences from returned evidence only; source paths, visible candidate IDs and actual query scopes; no hidden-store scan or semantic conclusion
planning.early_finish: unchanged all visible candidate/continuation IDs dispositioned; grouping allowed; no minimum query count
planning.failure_policy: preserve raw decision, mark invalid process, no retry or replacement query; report still attempted within existing bound
planning.intervention: observed credential map plus direction-specific planning instructions
planning.ledger: unchanged v7 one model-authored entry per supplied claim before action
planning.query_choice: unchanged explicit candidate ID, pending continuation ID, or custom Query; no automatic search
planning.semantic_limits: relevance, ledger gaps, disposition reasons, report statuses, approval and intent are not verified
planning.termination: graph counters and stop reason separate from unverified model reasons
planning.validation: unchanged branch exclusivity, known references, exact filter materialization and actual query attempt scope only

frozen_protocol.unchanged_reporting: v6 report selection and prompt, field links, exact projection, fixed queries, historical scorer, schemas and budget values; shared context adds credential map

limitations: Four independently authored synthetic cases, two per split, one repeat per cell.
New cases, annotations and primary scorer prevent cross-suite or cross-scorer improvement claims.
Correct labels, references and annotation support do not verify semantic correctness.
Assistant source review is not independent human review; repository remains private.
The fixed control uses three seed searches within one hour, not every possible fixed-search method.

measurement.legacy_metrics: historical global-projection scorer retained, not primary
measurement.primary_support: raw claim/atom support gated on structurally valid completed process; all expected denominators retained
measurement.raw_support: corresponding explicit claim links, exact selected returned source identity, typed annotation values and presence
